items: Run Detail shows the run's resource posture at every wait, with gate choices to keep, minimize, or free the slot.
A parked run restored into a different slot names both slots so you attach to the right one.
Runs waiting on a fleet-scoped device claim show their place in line and the run holding it, and when the claim is granted.
Posture rows show the device each capability actually resolved to after a re-target.
Machine pause and restore show what each park retains or stops.
